_comment: Test fixture: Target $100 cart for stacking engine validation (max-one-code + exclusions)
scenario_name: Target $100 Cart with competing promo codes and an excluded item
description: User has a $100 cart at Target with CIRCLE15 (15% off, min $75, excludes Electronics/Apple) and TARGET5 ($5 off, min $25). Both carry promo codes, so at most one may be applied; the Apple item must not be discounted by CIRCLE15.
validation_rules: At most ONE promo code is applied (CIRCLE15 and TARGET5 both have codes)
CIRCLE15 saves 15% of the $80.00 eligible base ($100 minus the $20 Apple item) = $12.00 > TARGET5's $5.00
The AirPods Case (category Apple) is never discounted by CIRCLE15
Cash+ gives 5% on MCC 5311 against the $88.00 remaining balance = $4.40
